description: arXiv:2607.06166v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed beliefs into prices that act as probabilistic forecasts of uncertain events. Classical theory establishes how a better-than-market forecast can yield positive trading profit. However, it hinges crucially on the specific automated market maker (AMM) design, and is not applicable to popular exchanges today...
author: Anri Gu, Nicole Kagan, Alec Sun, Jibang Wu, Haifeng Xu
